extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Conversion of days, hours, minutes — 1 day = 24 hours, 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 minute = 60 seconds. Bigger to smaller: multiply (2 days = 2x24 = 48 hours). Smaller to bigger: divide (180 minutes = 180/60 = 3 hours). Reading a clock: short hand = hours, long hand = minutes. a.m. = before noon (midnight to 12 noon), p.m. = after noon (12 noon to midnight). 24-hour clock: 1:00 p.m. = 13:00, 6:00 p.m. = 18:00. (2) Approximate elapsed time — find the time between two events. Train departs 7:30 a.m., arrives 11:30 a.m. = 4 hours. School starts 8:00 a.m., ends 2:00 p.m. = 6 hours. Use a clock or timeline to calculate. (3) Pictorial representation — pictograph uses picture symbols to show data. 1 symbol = 5 students. 4 symbols = 20 students. Key/legend tells what each symbol represents. (4) Bar graph interpretation — bars show quantities. Tallest bar = most. Shortest bar = least. Read the height against the scale on the y-axis. Labels on x-axis show categories. Title tells what the graph is about. (5) Growing and reducing patterns — growing: each step increases by a fixed amount (5, 8, 11, 14 — increases by 3). Reducing: each step decreases by a fixed amount (20, 17, 14, 11 — decreases by 3). The fixed amount is the rate of change. (6) Rules for extending patterns — find the rule by comparing consecutive terms. If difference is +3, rule is 'add 3 each time'. If difference is -5, rule is 'subtract 5 each time'. Use the rule to find the next terms. Misconceptions: '1 hour = 100 minutes' (1 hour = 60 minutes, not 100 — time uses base 60, not base 10), 'a.m. and p.m. are the same' (a.m. is BEFORE noon, p.m. is AFTER noon — they are opposite halves of the day), 'the tallest bar means the least' (the TALLEST bar means the MOST — height represents quantity), 'all patterns grow by 1' (patterns can grow or reduce by ANY fixed amount — 2, 3, 5, 10, etc.), 'a growing pattern can decrease' (a GROWING pattern always INCREASES, a REDUCING pattern always DECREASES — they are opposite directions). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function TimeDataPatternsGame), NOT export default. Export interface TimeDataPatternsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
